description: Defines serialization and deserialization functions for torch::Tensor, torch::IValue, and related classes, including save and load templates, and pickle functions.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes a value or vector of tensors to a specified destination.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Deserializes a value or vector of tensors from a specified source.

methods.name: pickle_save
methods.description: Serializes a torch::IValue into a vector of chars.

methods.name: pickle_load
methods.description: Deserializes a vector of chars into a torch::IValue.
